title: DR-1: AppSync = AppDataUpdate
description: protocol-06 uses 'AppSync' (§2, §4.2 L889-903, §5.3 L1360) and 'AppDataUpdate' (§4.3.2, §5.4, §7.5, §7.6) for one operation; barnes-mls-appsync-01 §9 is the precursor of ext-10 §4.7. Read every AppSync proposal as ext-10 AppDataUpdate (0x0008); mimiParticipantList -> participant_list 0x0022; mimiRoomPolicy -> room-policy-04 §10.1 components.
